changes.text: 1858年6月30日，伦敦。两位林奈学会会员莱尔与胡克联名给林奈学会秘书贝内特写信，随信附上几份材料；信里说，这些材料都关于同一个主题。麻烦在于：同一套理论被两个人各自独立想了出来，而两个人都没把它发表出去。信里说，二人都可以公平地要求享有作为这一重要研究方向上原创思想者的功绩。

London, 30 June 1858. Charles Lyell and J. D. Hooker, both Fellows of the Linnean Society, wrote a joint letter to J. J. Bennett, secretary of the Linnean Society, enclosing papers which, they said, "all relate to the same subject". The difficulty was: the same theory had occurred to two men working independently of each other, and neither had published. The two men, the letter says, "may both fairly claim the merit of being original thinkers in this important line of inquiry."

先把两位当事人摆出来。达尔文这边，有一份关于物种的手稿：1839年草拟，1844年誊写，胡克在1844年读过誊本，内容后来又告诉了莱尔。多年里，莱尔和胡克反复催达尔文把观点发表出来，他一直没有。华莱士这边，1854年出发去东印度，用近八年考察了马来群岛的大部分岛屿和部分巴布亚，研究那里的动植物；更早的1848年，他与贝茨同赴巴西，走亚马逊和内格罗河的原始森林，1852年返英，他那批尤以鸟类和植物见长的收藏，大半毁于海难。1877年的一篇人物小传记下关键的一句：他在马来群岛研究时并不知道达尔文在同一方向上的先前工作，却得出了几乎相同的结论。

Begin with the two men themselves. Darwin had a manuscript on species: drafted in 1839, copied out in 1844. Hooker read that copy in 1844, and its contents later reached Lyell. For years the two of them pressed Darwin to publish his views; for years he held back. Wallace, meanwhile, was travelling. He set out for the East Indies in 1854 and spent nearly eight years exploring the greater part of the islands of the Malay Archipelago and parts of Papua, studying their animals and plants. Earlier, in 1848, he had gone to Brazil with Bates, through the primeval forests of the Amazon and the Rio Negro, and returned to England in 1852; his collections, especially rich in birds and plants, were largely destroyed by shipwreck. A sketch published in 1877 supplies the decisive sentence: while pursuing his researches in the Malay Archipelago, Wallace was unaware of Darwin's earlier labours in the same direction, yet arrived at almost the same general conclusions.
据达尔文本人所说，那份旧手稿从未打算发表：1858年，他为它加了一条脚注，署“C. D. 1858”，说明这份手稿从未打算发表，因此写得并不仔细。

By Darwin's own account, his old manuscript was never intended for publication. In 1858 he added a footnote to it: "This MS. work was never intended for publication, and therefore was not written with care.—C. D. 1858."

第三份材料是华莱士的论文，标题《论变种无限偏离原初类型的倾向》，落款特尔纳特，1858年2月。据莱尔和胡克的信，这篇论文是写给朋友兼通信者达尔文看的，华莱士寄出时表示：如果达尔文认为它足够新颖、有意思，就请转给莱尔。两份材料的开头读来很不一样。达尔文的摘录从德堪多讲起：德堪多曾雄辩地宣称，整个自然都处在战争之中，生物与生物相争，或与外部自然相争；随后又说，这就是马尔萨斯的学说，而且多数情形下作用强了十倍。华莱士则从一条反对意见讲起：家养变种不稳定，任其自然便常常回到亲本的样子，有人以此认为物种是分别创造、永远不变的。出发点不同，落点接近。

The third item was Wallace's essay, "On the Tendency of Varieties to depart indefinitely from the Original Type," dated Ternate, February 1858. According to Lyell and Hooker's letter, it was written for his friend and correspondent Darwin to read, and sent with the expressed wish that, "if Mr. Darwin thought it sufficiently novel and interesting," it should be forwarded to Lyell. The two openings read very differently. Darwin's extract opens from De Candolle: "De Candolle, in an eloquent passage, has declared that all nature is at war, one organism with another, or with external nature." A few sentences later it calls the struggle "the doctrine of Malthus applied in most cases with tenfold force." Wallace opens from an objection - that domestic varieties are unstable and tend to revert to the parent form, which is taken to show that species were created distinct and are kept that way. Different starting points, converging destinations.
小传还顺笔记下华莱士后来的路：1862年回英国，此后多年整理他庞大的收藏——100,000余件昆虫标本、8,000多只鸟；1868年获皇家学会颁发的皇家奖章，1870年获巴黎地理学会金质奖章，同年出版《自然选择理论文集》。在人类起源问题上，他承认自然选择对达尔文归于它的多数变化有效，但否认单靠自然选择、没有某种更高原因的共同作用，就能完成从类人猿到人的过渡。

The sketch also follows Wallace's later course. He returned to England in 1862 and spent several years classifying an enormous collection - upward of 100,000 insect specimens and more than 8,000 birds. In 1868 he received the royal medal from the Royal Society; in 1870 the Geographical Society of Paris gave him its gold medal, and in that same year he published "Contributions to the Theory of Natural Selection". On human origins, though he recognized the efficacy of natural selection in producing most of the changes Darwin attributed to it, he denied that it was competent, without the joint agency of some higher cause, to effect the transition from the anthropoid apes to man.

作者把他们的做法概括为：算，但要公开兑现。作者列出的替代做法至少有三种，各有代价：由达尔文先单独发表；只发华莱士，把达尔文的优先权留给他日后自述；或者都等达尔文的完整著作出来再说。其中第二种与信中所记达尔文的倾向相对应：他提议尽快发表华莱士的论文，并强烈倾向于扣下自己的手稿；其余两种是作者提出的对照选项，不是材料里的记载。实际被选中的是第四条：三份材料同场宣读，日期写进正文，理由写给一位秘书并公开发表。莱尔和胡克自己说，这样做的依据是让经年思考、建立在大量事实上的观点立刻成为别人可以出发的目标。分配交给了程序，当事人让步的意愿只是其中一步。

The author's summary of their course is: yes, but it has to be cashed in publicly. The author sets out at least three alternative courses, each with its own price: Darwin publishing alone first; only Wallace published, with Darwin left to state his own priority later; or everyone waiting for Darwin's complete book. The second corresponds to the inclination the letter records in Darwin: he proposed that Wallace's essay be published as soon as possible, and was strongly inclined to withhold his own memoir; the other two are options constructed by the author for contrast, not episodes recorded in the documents. The course actually taken was a fourth: three sets of material read together in one session, the dates printed in the body of the text, the reasoning addressed to a secretary and made public. The warrant Lyell and Hooker gave was that views founded on a wide deduction from facts and matured by years of reflection should at once become a goal from which others might start. The allocation was handed to a procedure; a party's willingness to give way was one step in it.

dispositions.rationale: 信头只显示两人共同的头衔是 F.L.S.，胡克的皇家学会头衔为 V.P.R.S.。中英文均已改为“两位林奈学会会员”/“both Fellows of the Linnean Society”，删去“都是皇家学会会员”这一推断。

evidence.quote: Sir Charles Lyell , F.R.S., F.L.S., and J. D. Hooker , Esq., M.D., V.P.R.S., F.L.S.

dispositions.rationale: 按证据补上“大部分”这一限定：中文改为“考察了马来群岛的大部分岛屿和部分巴布亚”，英文改为“the greater part of the islands of the Malay Archipelago”。

evidence.quote: explored the greater part of the islands constituting the Malay Archipelago

dispositions.rationale: 首句改为归于达尔文本人的说法（“据达尔文本人所说”/“By Darwin's own account”），不再由叙述者直接断言。脚注引述保持不变。

evidence.quote: This MS. work was never intended for publication

dispositions.rationale: 中文删去易与本文作者混淆的“作者表示”，改为“据莱尔和胡克的信……华莱士寄出时表示”。英文补“According to Lyell and Hooker's letter”，并按证据用词改为 expressed wish，标明这一意愿是信中转述的。

evidence.quote: sent to him with the expressed wish that it should be forwarded to Sir Charles Lyell

dispositions.rationale: 中文改为“获皇家学会颁发的皇家奖章”，补回奖项名；英文同步改为与证据一致的“received the royal medal from the Royal Society”，中英对应。

evidence.quote: he received the royal medal from the Royal Society

dispositions.rationale: 中文末句改为“当事人让步的意愿只是其中一步”，与英文 willingness to give way 对齐。这样就不再暗示让步已经发生：达尔文的倾向被二人的条件拦下，他实际做的是授权二人处置手稿。英文保持原样。

evidence.quote: as he was strongly inclined to do (in favour of Mr. Wallace)
he gave us permission to make what use we thought proper of his memoir
